sections.heading: Crafting
sections.body: Crafting an item costs materials, and the item you craft receives a base of 500 Potential. The item receives an additional 10 Potential for every crafting level you have for that specific item type (armor, jewelry, or weapon).

sections.heading: Tempering
sections.body: Every tempering action costs 1 Potential, and has four different types of outcomes.

sections.heading: Outcomes
sections.body:
Critical -> Turns the item into a Masterpiece or Growth Item.
Positive -> Increase item exp by 1. Reaching 10 item exp upgrades the item to the next rarity. Each increase in rarity decreases the chance for a positive outcome.
Negative -> A negative outcome has a 5% chance of happening. This increases by +5% for every increase in rarity.
A negative outcome either decrease item exp, or consumes 1 extra potential.
Neutral -> Does nothing.
